notes: Printed: 'Target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn. Then it fights up to one target creature you don't control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)' X = 2: the lifelink 2/2 becomes 4/4 and fights the 3/3: each creature deals damage equal to its power (CR 701.12a), so the Leech deals 4 (the Ogre dies) and its lifelink gains its controller 4 (CR 702.15b: any damage dealt by a lifelink source); the Ogre deals 3 to the 4/4 Leech, which survives with 3 damage marked.
